verdict.rationale: Railway documents deploying apps from a connected repo with automatic configuration. It also provisions networking, SSL and load balancing at deploy time, so full-stack apps run without the developer managing servers. Nothing in the pack documents a serverless-functions capability, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented serverless/function deployment model, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-server-management experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Railway reads your code and sets the right settings, automatically.
Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
Railway is an all-in-one intelligent cloud provider that makes it easy to provision infrastructure, develop locally, and deploy to the cloud.
